recon.control_definition: Control - Untreated (no biostimulant application, but with standard fertilization)
recon.treatment_definition: Five biostimulant treatments: Baltic Sea algal extract (1.0 L/ha), Ascophyllum nodosum extract (1.0 L/ha), Spirulina platensis extract at three rates (1.0, 1.5, 1.8 L/ha). Two reference products: Forthial (1.0 L/ha), Asahi SL (0.6 L/ha)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Reference products Forthial and Asahi SL are commercial biostimulants, not controls - do not use as control group
recon.sample_size_source: The experiments were performed in randomized complete blocks in four replications (N=4) for each tested product
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain yield (t/ha) from Table 5 for each of the 5 biostimulant treatments vs control. Spirulina has 3 rates so extract as 3 separate comparisons. Do not use Forthial or Asahi SL as controls - they are reference biostimulants. Use SD values from tables. Each comparison should have n=4 per group.
